capabilities: Browse vault-wide property names with usage counts
Apply batch add, update, rename, and remove operations on selected notes
Filter notes by property conditions and boolean search
Preview before-and-after values and undo saved batches
Suggest existing values and flag typos, formatting, and inconsistencies
extras: Recommends keeping a separate vault backup and testing small batches first; local history and backup files contain full note content and should stay private. Requires Obsidian 1.5.7 or newer.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to survey property usage across a vault or safely add, rename, update, and remove properties on many notes at once.
summary: Batch property editor that browses vault properties, applies filtered bulk edits with previews, and undoes saved changes.
